verdict.rationale: BILL documents registrable webhook subscriptions that send real-time notifications to a customer `notificationUrl`. Spend & Expense events are explicitly covered, and the webhook API documents S&E-specific errors. Deliveries are HMAC-SHA256 signed via the x-bill-sha-signature header, with a documented limit of 10 subscriptions per organization. Missing for 10: S&E-specific event catalog and payload samples (the samples shown are AP bill/payment events), retry/delivery-guarantee semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
